paper.title_en: Compact and Long-Term Stable Polarization Entangled Photon-Pair Source
paper.abstract_en: We present a robust, compact polarization-entangled photon-pair source based on bulk optics that achieves long-term stability, a spectral pair generation rate of $4.24 \times 10^6$ pairs s$^{-1}$ mW$^{-1}$ nm$^{-1}$ constant for pump powers up to 700 mW, an intrinsic heralding efficiency of 59.8% , and a polarization contrast visibility of 99.6%. The source is mechanically designed for vibrational robustness, employing an engineered base plate and a reduced optical layout for less alignment sensitivity and complexity. It operates at telecom wavelengths in C-band with a typical type-0 SPDC spectral output of 70 nm width. We demonstrate its integration into a deployed entanglement-based QKD system that bridges the gap between laboratory prototypes and practical quantum communication hardware.
